The way you carry yourself matters just as much as what you wear. 3. **Experiment**: If you enjoy this look, try playing with textures, colors, or accessories to keep it fresh. Or, if you want to explore other styles, do that too—confidence grows when you feel comfortable in different spaces. 4. **Mindset Shift**: Sometimes, confidence is a choice.
